sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Elphin, also spelled Elffin, is a Welsh hero. He is the foster father of the great poet Taliesin. His own father sent him to a fish weir, and told him that there his fortune must be found. In the water he brought up the child Taliesin, a boy reborn and full of light from the sea. Elphin took the boy home and raised him with love. The boy repaid him with affection. He often drew Elphin out of danger that his own faults had brought on.
